Security verdict: BLOCK

PR: #152
Head: 0c01b1b8cfac84d9e83704bb955e9180365a9a4e
Scope: only 5aee7a1..0c01b1b, including relevant main-merge preservation. Graded against clarified C32.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | 🟡 MEDIUM | crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs | 2083-2087, 1975-1989 | Unbound holder assertion becomes another seat's message author | 9/10 |

S152-001 remains OPEN under C32(1). The accepted context-free exception is not limited to a request-state assertion: caller A supplies no identity context, names stored holder B as from, correlates to B's delivered request, and sends an arbitrary message to C. The handler preserves B as author and submits the supplied recipient/body to delivery.

store.mjs:866-869,1922-1929 renders the sender into "[pij from B]" and injects the body without unbound attribution. FYIs also preserve B through http/mod.rs:2226-2234, delivery/mod.rs:756-762 and core/fyi.rs:174-190. B neither sent nor authorized the message.

C32 explicitly excludes sending as another seat. The Known limit describes clock suppression, not this visible message-author impersonation. Raw-from messaging predates round2; this is the remaining correlated-reply boundary, not a duplicated149 finding or a demand for stronger cryptographic origin.

Required repair: reject context-free correlated message delivery, or separate the permitted holder-state assertion into a no-delivery operation. Do not reuse an unbound claim as Msg.from. Update the exact Known limit afterward.

Closed repairs:
- C32(2) refusal downgrade is CLOSED: identity refusals propagate before routing; native sender mismatches reject before enqueue. Shim derives sender and propagates refusal.
- F006/C32(3) is CLOSED in source: role_requests.rs:736-772 writes the first stamp and audit in one owned transaction. Append failure rolls back both; replay duplicates neither. Owned publication removes the prior cancellation split.
- Accepted-answer markers replace HTTP-status inference; refused role receipts stay unmarked. Stored delivered state/holder controls answer authority. Audit payload is body-free.

Source tests cover refused native/shim replies, contradictory/matching identities and atomic append failure/retry/shared-field idempotence. They do not establish neutral sender or no delivery for the context-free path.

Evidence: exact-head CI42387589437 and latest Delivers42387613058 independently verified SUCCESS; PR reports CLEAN.

No local builds/tests, canary reruns, spoofing requests, credential reads or product edits. Prior fixture-model proof limits remain.
